title: HTML Development Track
description: Master HTML from the ground up — from your first tags to SEO-optimised, accessible, production-ready pages. 7 comprehensive modules covering every key topic used in professional web development.

moduleDetails.title: HTML Fundamentals
moduleDetails.description: Tags, elements, attributes, and your first web pages.

moduleDetails.title: Page Structure & Semantic HTML
moduleDetails.description: Semantic elements, headings, lists, links, and navigation.

moduleDetails.title: Forms & User Input
moduleDetails.description: All form controls, validation, accessibility, and styling hooks.

moduleDetails.title: Media & Embedding
moduleDetails.description: Video, audio, iframes, responsive images with picture/srcset, and inline SVG.

moduleDetails.title: Tables
moduleDetails.description: Accessible data tables, thead/tbody/tfoot, colspan, and rowspan.

moduleDetails.title: Advanced HTML
moduleDetails.description: SEO meta tags, Open Graph, custom data attributes, entities, and Schema.org.

moduleDetails.title: Best Practices & Capstone
moduleDetails.description: Code organization, accessibility audits, performance, W3C validation, and progressive enhancement.
